_changelog: 2026-04-20 Phase A1: L3 CubiCasa5k CNN now runs on every page including text PDFs. Against the Fire RFIs text-only PDF it misidentifies table-row separators as walls (~14 on page 0). This is expected behavior; L3 is tuned for floor plans, not text documents. wall_count_lte was raised from 5 to 50 and warnings_empty changed to false to reflect the new l3_cubicasa_wall_count warning. Real floor-plan pages (e.g. 1881 arch page 1) produce 195 semantically-correct walls vs L1's 141k false positives.

2026-07-16: The source-controlled checkout does not contain the optional CubiCasa5k vendor or weights. Its deterministic L1 fallback returns zero walls, zero rooms, and no warnings on this text-only RFI page, so warnings_empty now records the repository default instead of an untracked local ML installation.
